targets.name: oddSum
targets.meaning: For every natural n, the sum of the first n odd positive integers equals n squared.
targets.definition:
def oddSum : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => oddSum n + (n + n + 1)
targets.statement: theorem candidate (n : Nat) : oddSum n = (n * n)

targets.name: evenSum
targets.meaning: For every natural n, the sum of the first n positive even integers equals n squared plus n.
targets.definition:
def evenSum : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => evenSum n + (n + n + 1 + 1)
targets.statement: theorem candidate (n : Nat) : evenSum n = ((n * n) + n)
